title: ID0444189-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / PN 170001120] Charger doesn't turn on
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: When we pressed FC12, any of FC13-17 doesn't turn on. Only FC12 has green LED on. Also TB18 LED is also turned off.
Solution: Bridges between the fuses replaced
